newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends lower after hitting nine-month low.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends lower after hitting nine-month low.

text.p: IPE Brent futures plummeted to a new nine month low in the final hour of trade on Friday to settle below the $18 psychogical support level some 50 cents down at $17.67 per tonne.
The May IPE contract plunged to as low as $17.65 in the final hour of trade having spent most the session some 9-10 cents up on Thursday's close.
Traders said a break below $19.35 a barrel by May NYMEX crude had sparked the fall on the IPE.
"Everyone was jumping on the back of a break through support," said one trader.
The next nearest low on the prompt month chart lies at $17.48 a barrel, the low of June 14.

Some traders had suggested that the moderate gains seen earlier in the session meant prices -- which have fallen 25 percent in the last three months -- were in for a period of consolidation, but most remained cautious citing concerns about crude oversupply which continued to linger in the background.
"I didn't want to this happen," said one trader. "And I'm not sure the fall is over now that WTI's broken through the $19.19 level," said one trader. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
